insights.title: Improve with AI: {{topic}}
insights.description: For each of today's themes the AI writes a clear title, a summary and a suggested angle, and merges themes about the same story. It only uses the collected titles and excerpts.

x.title: Search X: {{title}}
x.description: TALeport does not read X directly: it asks Grok to search recent posts and saves the answer as a source of the theme.
x.chatHint: Uses your grok.com account: copy the prompt, send it and paste the answer here.
x.apiHint: Automatic search with your xAI key; the cost goes into the spend counter.
x.apiNoKey: Add an xAI key in Settings to use this option.
x.saved: Answer saved as the theme's “X via Grok” source.

topic.title: Create with AI
topic.describe: Describe the topic to monitor in one sentence
topic.placeholder: E.g. AI news useful to small businesses
topic.review: The AI fills in the topic fields: check and edit them before saving.

placeholder.title: Under construction
placeholder.body: This section arrives in development phase {{phase}}.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: App preferences. They stay on this PC only.

ai.title: Default AI
ai.description: TALeport also works without AI. With Ollama (free, on your PC), an API key (paid) or your own chat in the browser you get titles, summaries, proposals and drafts.
ai.autoInsights: After each scan, improve themes with the default AI
ai.autoInsightsHint: Only when the default AI is Ollama or an API key. With API keys every scan has a small cost.
ai.prefill: Try to prefill the prompt on the chat site (experimental)
ai.prefillHint: Works only with short prompts and on some sites, when you are already signed in. The prompt is copied to the clipboard anyway.

keys.title: API keys
keys.description: Keys are stored in the Windows Credential Manager, never in the app's files or backups. All of them are optional.
keys.youtubeQuota: YouTube quota today: {{remaining}} units left out of {{limit}}

scan.title: Scan
scan.description: The daily scan starts at the chosen time. If the PC is off at that time, it starts as soon as you reopen TALeport.
scan.startWithWindows: Start TALeport with Windows (minimized to the system tray)
scan.closeToTray: Closing the window minimizes to the system tray
scan.closeToTrayHint: This way scheduled scans run even with the window closed. To quit, use the menu of the icon near the clock.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.internal: Internal app error. Details are in the error log.
errors.network: Can't reach the app engine. Try restarting TALeport.

secrets.unavailable: The Windows Credential Manager is not available.

topics.invalid: Check the topic fields: some values are not valid.
topics.keywords_required: Add at least one keyword in one of the chosen languages.
topics.limit: You can have at most {{max}} topics.

scan.no_topics: There are no active topics to scan.
scan.finished_with_errors: The scan finished with some errors.

source.http: The source answered with an error ({{status}}).
source.rate_limited: The source limited our requests: try again later.

rss.invalid_feed: The RSS feed is not valid.

reddit.blocked: Reddit blocked the requests: source paused for this scan.
reddit.rate_limited: Reddit limited the requests: source paused for this scan.

youtube.no_key: No YouTube key: add it in Settings to use this source.
youtube.key_invalid: The YouTube key is invalid or the API is not enabled.
youtube.quota_exhausted: Today's YouTube quota is used up: it resumes tomorrow.

trends.invalid_feed: Google Trends answered in an unexpected format.

ai.no_key: The {{provider}} API key is missing: add it in Settings.
ai.key_invalid: The {{provider}} API key is invalid or lacks the required permissions.
ai.model_not_found: The model “{{model}}” doesn't exist or isn't available.
ai.rate_limited: {{provider}} limited the requests: try again shortly.
ai.timeout: The AI didn't answer in time. Try again or pick a faster model.
ai.ollama_missing: Ollama is not installed. You can download it for free from ollama.com.
ai.ollama_installed_not_running: Ollama is installed but not running.

ai.description_required: Write a description of the topic.

generator.too_many: Too many posts at once: max {{max}}. Reduce networks, languages or variants.
generator.series_range: The series goes from 1 to {{max}} posts.
generator.no_posts: The answer has no posts for the chosen networks and languages.

content.unreadable: Can't read the file. Is it protected or damaged?
content.too_large: The file is larger than {{max_mb}} MB.
content.unsupported_format: Unsupported format: use PDF, DOCX or TXT.

content.too_short: The content is too short: at least 200 characters are needed.

ask.unknown_topic: The plan uses a topic that doesn't exist.
ask.invalid_plan: The analysis plan is not valid.

results.not_published: Results can only be entered on posts marked as published.

calendar.published: A post that is already published cannot be moved.

topics.title: Topics
topics.limitReached: You reached the maximum of {{max}} topics
topics.emptyBody: A topic tells TALeport what to look for: keywords in your languages, sources to follow and your audience. You can create up to {{max}}.
topics.notMonitored: Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and LinkedIn are not monitored: they offer no free, permitted access to their content. TALeport uses news, YouTube, Reddit and Google Trends.
topics.confirmDelete: Delete the topic and its links?

placeholders.name: E.g. AI in marketing
placeholders.description: What it is about and why it matters to you

hints.editions: For each language pick the source countries: they set the Google News edition, the YouTube region and Google's trends.
hints.keywords: Write the keywords for each chosen language. They are searched as whole phrases.
hints.pickEdition: Pick at least one language and country above.
hints.exclude: Items containing these words are discarded.
hints.sources: RSS feeds, YouTube channels and subreddits to always follow, even without keywords.
hints.style: 3 to {{max}} posts you wrote: the AI will imitate your style.

items.title: Collected items
items.description: The latest items found for this topic.
items.empty: No items yet: start a scan.

today.noTopicsBody: Create your first topic: every day TALeport will look for news, videos and discussions, and the hottest themes will show up here.
today.noItems: No items yet today: start a scan.
today.noThemes: No hot themes: today's items don't share subjects yet.

themes.aiLater: The AI-written summary arrives in phase 4.
themes.noQuestions: No questions found in YouTube comments or on Reddit.
themes.angleLater: The suggested angle to tell this story arrives with AI in phase 4.

why.title: Why it's hot
why.volume: {{today}} items today, against an average of {{average}} on previous days
why.volumeNew: New theme: {{today}} items today, no history yet
why.diversity_one: Only one source talks about it

themes.statsSummary_one: {{count}} item collected today from: {{sources}}. Words that appear together: {{related}}.
themes.statsSummary_other: {{count}} items collected today from: {{sources}}. Words that appear together: {{related}}.
themes.xHint: What people say on X, collected with Grok.
themes.xEmpty: No X searches for this theme yet.
themes.writtenByAi: Title, summary and angle written by the AI from the collected items.

generator.subtitle: Post drafts based on the theme's sources, in the right format for each network. You publish them by hand.
generator.noThemes: No themes today: start a scan from the Today screen.
generator.coveredHint: You already published on a similar theme: the AI will look for a different angle.

longContent.subtitle: Paste a text or upload a document: TALeport turns it into a coherent series of posts to publish on different days.
longContent.formats: PDF, DOCX or TXT, up to 15 MB
longContent.title: Content title
longContent.placeholder: Paste an article, a transcript or a document here…
longContent.truncated: The text was very long and has been shortened to its first part.

drafts.factCheck: Check before publishing (not found in the sources)
drafts.regenerateHint: A new version of this post, different from the current one.

trends.subtitle: The words and hashtags that appear most in the collected items, how they change and where.
trends.shareHint: The percentage is the share of the period's items that mention the word.
trends.noHashtags: No hashtags in this period's items.
trends.trendHint: Items per day mentioning each word.
trends.changesHint: Compared with the previous period, from {{start}} to {{end}}.
trends.noHistory: Data from the previous period is needed: emerging and falling words show up after a few days of scans.

ask.title: Ask
ask.subtitle: Ask a question about the collected data. Ready-made questions answer at once; others are turned by the AI into an analysis of your data, without invented numbers.

presets.hashtags_month: Which hashtags were used most in the last month?
presets.languages_month: How do words differ across languages in the last month?
presets.hot_themes_week: Which themes were hottest this week?
presets.this_vs_last_week: What changed compared with last week?
presets.posts_month: How many posts did I generate and publish in the last month?

ask.pdfLater: PDF export of answers arrives in phase 8.

sentence.posts: You generated {{generated}} drafts and published {{published}} posts.

ask.noMetrics: No results entered for these posts yet: add them from the Archive (likes, comments, shares, views).

notifications.settingsDescription: The bell at the top always collects everything. Here you choose whether to also use Windows notifications.
notifications.windowsHint: Spike on a topic, scan completed or recovered, source not working, spending cap almost reached. Scans you start yourself only show in the bell.

scan_recovered.title: Missed scan recovered
scan_recovered.body: The PC was off at the scheduled time, so the scan ran at startup. {{new}} new items.

source_failing.title: Source not working: {{source}}
source_failing.body: {{source}} did not respond during the scan. {{reason}}

spend_reached.title: Spending cap reached
spend_reached.body: Spend this month ${{total}} (cap ${{cap}}): paid calls are paused and “Open in chat” is used instead.

results.hint: Copy the numbers from the platform. Leave blank what you do not know; they show which themes and formats work.

reason.platform: Suggested because posts on {{platform}} got {{metric}} ({{value}} on average).
reason.theme_other: Priority: the {{count}} posts on similar themes (“{{theme}}”) got {{metric}} ({{value}} on average).

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.subtitle: Drag drafts onto days: the time is the suggested one for the platform, and you can change it.
calendar.dragHint: You can also click a draft to pick the day and time with the keyboard.
calendar.publishedNote: This post is already published: it stays on the calendar as a record.
calendar.timeHint: Without a time, the one already chosen or the platform's suggested time is used.
calendar.postingTimesHint: Starting values you can change. Once you enter post results, the app suggests the hour that worked best.
calendar.learned: From your results: {{time}} ({{posts}} posts, {{average}} interactions on average)

archive.subtitle: Every post and theme, with free-text search. Enter results on published posts.

searchPlaceholder.posts: Words in the post text or theme
searchPlaceholder.themes: Words in the title or summary

spend.title: API spend
spend.description: Estimate for each call from the price list (or the real cost when the provider reports it), monthly total and cap.
spend.meter: This month's spend against the cap
spend.capReached: Cap reached: paid calls are paused until next month and AI features switch to “Open in chat” on their own. Ollama stays available.
spend.capHint: Once the cap is reached, the app makes no more paid calls. Leave blank for no cap.
